criteria.name: Correct identity and source-backed footprint
evidence: Purdue GIS feature FID 433 identifies LMBS / Lambertus Hall at 363 N Grant St..
The GIS ring has 39 distinct perimeter vertices; candidate shell has 39 per level.
Independent paired local-vertex comparison max error=1.88110211e-06 m; mean=6.5310384e-07 m.
Adjacent FID 432 is recorded as DUDL / Dudley Hall, reducing risk of selecting the neighboring GIS polygon.

criteria.name: Position, orientation, and scale/dimensions
evidence: Fresh-open shell is at local origin with unit scale; shell local bounds are [[-4.33110237121582, 21.982175827026367], [-34.17417907714844, 35.69482421875], [0.0, 16.0]] m.
Evidence placement origin differs from independent conversion by 0 m.
After applying that origin, shell bounds differ from source-derived global bounds by at most 9.57682914e-07 m.
The model uses the project's documented local approximate lon/lat conversion; no independent survey CRS or survey control is available.

criteria.name: Evidence-backed height, floors, and roof form
evidence: The asset is five levels and 16 m high, consistent with the cited fifth-floor Nuclear Engineering use and overall project imagery.
The top is modeled as a flat roof with parapet and a small screened plant; render 02 exposes the roof footprint.
The 16 m height and 3.1 m story spacing are explicitly estimates; no Lambertus-only elevation or measured height was found.
findings: Height and floor elevations remain estimates, and the rooftop plant has no Lambertus-specific source confirmation.

criteria.name: Facade, entrances, and distinctive architecture
evidence: The model includes glazed panels, brick-colored areas, concrete-colored piers/belts, terracotta-colored sunshades, and entry canopies.
The Ennead massing diagrams support a transparent ground level and multiple entry points; the BSA exterior photo supports glass, horizontal screening, and pale vertical structure.
The strongest exterior photo visibly labels Dudley Hall; the packet itself says exact Lambertus-vs-Dudley facade allocation is unclear.
findings: Facade rhythm/material mapping is only partly attributable to Lambertus; the render's repeated vertical shade fins and entrances are not checked against a Lambertus-only elevation.

criteria.name: Modular export, portability, and complete evidence
evidence: Independent fresh-open found scene 'Building_lambertus_hall', collection 'Asset_lambertus_hall', 102 mesh objects, and 14 assigned materials.
No linked libraries; missing external texture paths: 0.
Evidence includes raw FID 433 and FID 432 snapshots, design diagrams, project photography, three renders, coordinate method, and explicit uncertainty notes.
